_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), judged by the steps its rule takes: 1 adds up a line or steps along it; 2 needs one multiplication or division, plus a small change; 3 needs squares, cubes or roots; 4 needs two steps, digit sums, letters, four-number lines or two blanks. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
